entries.title: Follow a crewmate on another computer while it works
entries.body: With both computers updated, the Crewmate tab shows work during a turn, including calls that are still running. This also works with Claude. An empty tab no longer says the session has not started. A restarted computer no longer leaves the task marked as working when Claude was working on its own.
entries.noPicture: A still picture cannot show updates during unfinished work or recovery after a restart; the other changes clarify messages.
